newsitem.title: USA: Parlux finds no buyers, consolidates in Fla.
newsitem.headline: Parlux finds no buyers, consolidates in Fla.

text.p: Parlux Fragrances Inc said Friday that its hiring of Montgomery Securities did not result in definitive offers which would provide higher shareholder value.
Accordingly, the company said it will end its relationship with Montgomery, and to independently restructure itself based upon its available resources.
The company said that as part of that restructuring it would consolidate its worldwide operations in South Florida.
Non-recurring restructuring costs resulting from this strategy will be absorbed in the current fiscal quarter and year, said Parlux.
